name: CF-Div2-Stepfun
intro: CF-Div2-Stepfun 是一个评测大型语言模型竞赛编程能力的基准，选取2024年9月至2025年2月的CodeForces Division 2比赛题目以防止数据泄露。基准采用严格的离线沙箱评分，包含大量边界和压力测试，全面检验模型表现。
eval_feature: 防污染, 对抗测试, 离线沙箱评测
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.10604v2 Appendix E.2.1 and official Hugging Face snapshot f281a50536b9a6cd77f4c02c683dfe491342ac05. CF-Div2-Stepfun evaluates competitive programming models across 53 Division 2 tasks held post-September 2024 to prevent training contamination. Track A models problem curation, multi-tier test case synthesis (official samples, randomized large tests, handcrafted adversarial edge cases), and oracle soundness triage replaying accepted human submissions before freezing the 53 tasks. Track B models competitive prompt assembly, 8-sample program generation, offline sandbox grading (256MB RAM / 2.0s timeout), and Pass Rate, Accuracy, avg@8, and pass@8 metric reporting.
intro_en: CF-Div2-Stepfun is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' coding abilities, using CodeForces Division 2 problems from September 2024 to February 2025 to prevent data leakage. It employs strict offline sandbox scoring and includes extensive boundary and stress tests to comprehensively assess model performance.
